run_benchmark: run a TorchServe benchmark using a YAML config file with the auto_benchmark CLI
load_benchmark_config: load a benchmark configuration from a YAML file and parse it into a dict
install_torchserve: install TorchServe from source or pip for a specified version and hardware target
run_benchmark_models: run load tests against multiple model JSON configs and generate performance reports
clean_up_benchmark_env: clean up temporary benchmark directories including model store and workflow store
